# Example

> Example is a one-sentence summary of what this site is, who it is for, and what makes it useful. This is the sentence an assistant can quote.

Example is a [category] for [audience]. It [what it does] and [what it does not do]. Canonical origin: https://example.com

- Name: Example
- Website: https://example.com
- Type: [product / service / documentation / publication]
- Audience: [who]
- Price: [free / from X]
- Founder: [name, role]
- Language: [language]
- Independent: [yes/no, from whom]
- Contact: hello@example.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://example.com/index.md): what the product is and who it is for
- [Features](https://example.com/features.md): the main capabilities, with limits
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing.md): what it costs and what is included
- [About](https://example.com/about.md): who runs it and why
- [Facts](https://example.com/facts.md): the quotable facts, dates and contact

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://example.com/guides/getting-started.md): the first 10 minutes
- [How to do X](https://example.com/guides/how-to-x.md): a concrete method with examples

## Optional

- [Full text](https://example.com/llms-full.txt): every page in one file
